calls: CORRECTION: the luxury sidairi is not unclaimed. Noura Sulaiman (Riyadh) sells a cashmere sudairya at SAR 2,700 (SAR 3,105 incl. VAT), four of five colorways out of stock, with safari, sport and classic sub-lines. Mokharaz and Al Qattan sell cashmere and fur-lined sidairis. Cucinelli and Franck Namani gilets ($3,850-6,900) cover the very top.

STRENGTHENED: demand for the vest layer is proven across four price tiers, and the global gilet is moving toward slim, matte and cashmere. The open ground moves from 'own the sidairi' to 'own the full thobe layer system' and a SAR 4,000-7,000 Saudi-made tier (speculative).

NEW: Toteme menswear (Sept) launched with one Instagram video, hidden heritage details and its own menswear team. A model for heritage through detail. Highsnobiety: big houses now act like niche brands.
CONFIRMED: relaxed pleated trousers (Hermès SS27) for a tenth run; Paris SS27 lightness and relaxed tailoring (Dior, Saint Laurent). SS27 palette: olive, stone, tobacco, oatmeal, faded navy.
UPDATED: Westfield Riyadh now guided to Q4 2026 with an October preview. RFW lineup still unpublished. No follower recount (browser not approved in an unattended run).
